title: Ba
html_source: Egyptian symbol for the soul, usually depicted as a human-headed bird.

anchor.prefix: le coming back. She leaned on the sideboard watching. Moorish eyes. Twenty years asleep in Sleepy Hollow. All changed. Forgotten. The young are old. His gun rusty from the dew.
anchor.suffix: . What is that flying about? Swallow? Bat probably. Thinks I'm a tree, so blind. Have birds no smell? Metempsychosis. They believed you could be changed into a tree from grief. Wee
